definition: The chemoreceptor trigger zone refers to the area postrema, a small bulge beside the fourth ventricle in the medulla. Because it is outside the blood-brain barrier, it can detect substances in the body and contribute to the vomiting response.

provenance.scope: Source record D031608; pinned source text
